Elections
The City of Melrose Elections Office directs all Municipal, State, and Federal Elections within the City of Melrose. We conduct elections and oversee polling places, maintain voter registration records, and provide accurate and timely information to eligible Melrose voters and candidates for public office.
Elections Office Hours:
Monday - Thursday: 8:30AM - 3:30 PM
Friday: 8:30AM - 12:30 PM
Next Elections:
2026 State Primary - Tuesday Sept. 1, 2026 (Early Voting: 08/22 - 08/28)
2026 State Election - Tuesday Nov. 3, 2026 (Early Voting: 10/17 - 10/30)

View a sample ballot for Nov. 3, 2026.

.
Voting by Mail
You must apply each year in order to Vote by Mail. To Vote by Mail in 2026, please use the following link to the Secretary of State's Office:
https://www.sec.state.ma.us/divisions/elections/voting-information/vote-by-mail.htm
. You can also stop into the Melrose Elections Office at City Hall to pick up or complete a Vote by Mail application.
